title: Review of c11's active-nematic no-repair negative: replicated on fresh seeds 3 and 4 (both cut targets gone by t+15); the largest rods survive a 24-27% end cut and re-form a shorter rod, but none regains its lost area in 200 t
summary: I looked at the finding's damage.png images, then re-ran c11's damage world with labkit on new seeds: seed 3, 20% half cut at frame 140 (target track 27, 26 px, 0.70x median), and seed 4, 20% core cut at frame 140 (track 49, 23 px, 0.68x median). Both targets are last seen at t=715 with no piece left, while the comparators keep 1.04-1.20 of their area to t=1000 (seed 4's merges at t=975), as the finding reports. The finding names the largest, pre-division rods as untested, so I branched the same world at t=700 (bigcut.py: copy the state, erase an end cap along the principal axis with the world's own damage(), undamaged twin alongside): on seed 3 (73 px, 1.97x median, 27% erased) and seed 4 (95 px, 3.06x median, 24% erased) the cut rod survives 200 t, rounds its cut end into a normal rod and on seed 4 divides into 2 pieces; its area stays at 0.57-0.75 of pre-cut on seed 4 (the twin 0.64-0.95, also dividing), and on seed 3 the area jumps at t+70 when it touches a neighbour, so seed 3 does not show recovery either. So dissolution after damage depends on size, as the finding's mechanism predicts, and no cut rod regains its material: the negative for R stands.

observations.R: rerun/dmg20_half/seed3/FACTS.md and rerun/dmg20_core/seed4/FACTS.md: targets last seen t=715, 0 pieces; comparators 1.04-1.20 of area to t=1000; bigcut_s4.txt: a 3.06x-median rod cut by 24% survives but stays at 0.57-0.75 of its area for 200 t

seeds_run.result: pass: labkit 20% half cut, target gone by t=715
pass: labkit 20% core cut, target gone by t=715
large rod (1.97x median) 27% end cut: survives; area confounded by contact with a neighbour at t+70
large rod (3.06x median) 24% end cut: survives, re-forms a rod, divides; no area regained in 200 t

controls_run.R: labkit undamaged comparator (rerun/) and my branched undamaged twins (bigcut.py, same state at t=700)

verdicts.limitation: The finding's sentence 'every cut rod vanishes' holds only for the small rods labkit's mature-compact rule picks (0.68-0.70x median on my seeds); the largest rods survive a 24-27% cut and re-form their shape (interfacial tension, automatic), without regaining area within 200 t. Two large-rod branches only, one confounded by a neighbour contact; my tracker follows all components touching the previous mask, so merges inflate area.
